edits.new:
Then the field is named with MSG-P7-009

  Scenario: AC12 Business rules BR1 to BR10 (no legacy line)
    Given the stage runs on task queue rwb-treatment
    When each business rule of section 8 is exercised
    Then each rule BR1 to BR10 holds as stated in section 8
    Then each rule is asserted by its test case TC-E3-010-14 to TC-E3-010-23

  Scenario: AC13 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event
    Given a consumed event has already been applied
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then the inbox dedupes by cloud event id
    Then no second schedule, decision record or timer set is written

  Scenario: AC14 Activity retry and timeout
    Given the readBookingFacts activity fails or times out
    When the activity is retried or the timeout is reached
    Then the activity stores no partial schedule and the case stays where it was
    Then the retry policy values are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S2-E3010-APP-AC14)

  Scenario: AC15 Disallowed status change refused
    Given a case in a status the model does not allow for the booking outcome
    When the booking outcome is reported to the parent
    Then the transition is refused and nothing changes
